verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a chat thread where a developer can @-mention or tag an agent to discuss and delegate a bug or task. The closest features are adjacent rather than this capability: sending PR diff-line feedback or browser Design selections to an agent session, turning comments on shared designs and reports into updates, and launching agents from a prompt. A community user also describes Superset as terminal-centric rather than chat-centric.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task
